minutes.headline: Conservation Commission continued most hearings, approved a garage NOI, and backed a town-land transfer and Howard Street gift.
minutes.summary: Remote meeting with deed restriction wording (grading vs alteration) sent back to attorneys, a Mass Ave drainage issue referred to mosquito control, and hearings on a garage, a driveway, a shed and a greenhouse. The commission approved the garage and driveway notices, continued several hearings to October 7, endorsed the Howard Street land-gift plan, and authorized drafting warrant articles to move two parcels to its care and control. A resident objected that the warrant articles were not on the agenda.

what_happened.line: The commission voted to authorize its agent to draft warrant articles moving two town parcels to the commission's care and control.
It endorsed the open space committee's plan for buyers to gift rear land south of Maupus Brook at 250 Howard Street.
It approved notices of intent for a garage on Reservoir Road and a driveway on Northfield Road, the latter with a no-touch waiver and perpetual condition.
Hearings on Mass Ave, Bright Farms, Ruth Street, Townsend Harbor Road and Fire Road 16 were continued to October 7.
A resident objected that the warrant articles were not on the agenda, citing open meeting law.

why_it_matters: Moving parcels to the commission's care and control would change how that town land can be used, and any transfer would need a Town Meeting vote that residents will be asked to take.
The open meeting law objection raises a question of notice for the warrant article vote, which bears on how the public hears about land decisions before they reach the warrant.

Site visit at 1672 Mass Ave on October 3, and the revised 183 Island Road deed restriction wording returning for ratification.
